```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const controls = document.querySelectorAll(".topic-pills button[data-topic]");
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll("#listing-listing tbody tr");
  const emptyMessage = document.querySelector(".topic-empty");
  const topicCards = document.querySelectorAll(".topic-card[data-topic-card]");

  if (!controls.length || !rows.length) return;

  const decodeCategories = (value) => {
    if (!value) return [];

    try {
      return decodeURIComponent(atob(value))
        .split(",")
        .map((category) => category.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  };

  const categoriesByRow = new Map(
    Array.from(rows, (row) => [row, decodeCategories(row.dataset.categories)])
  );

  const countForTopic = (topic) => {
    if (topic === "all") return rows.length;

    return Array.from(categoriesByRow.values()).filter((categories) =>
      categories.includes(topic)
    ).length;
  };

  const formatCount = (count) => `${count} ${count === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}`;

  const updateCountLabels = () => {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-count-for]").forEach((element) => {
      const topic = element.dataset.countFor;
      const count = countForTopic(topic);

      if (element.classList.contains("site-metric")) {
        const value = element.querySelector(".site-metric-value");
        if (value) value.textContent = count;
        return;
      }

      if (element.classList.contains("site-card-count")) {
        element.textContent = formatCount(count);
      }
    });

    controls.forEach((control) => {
      let badge = control.querySelector(".topic-count");
      if (!badge) {
        badge = document.createElement("span");
        badge.className = "topic-count";
        control.appendChild(badge);
      }
      badge.textContent = countForTopic(control.dataset.topic);
    });
  };

  const applyFilter = (topic, shouldScroll = false) => {
    let visibleCount = 0;

    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const visible = topic === "all" || categoriesByRow.get(row).includes(topic);
      row.hidden = !visible;
      if (visible) visibleCount += 1;
    });

    controls.forEach((control) => {
      const active = control.dataset.topic === topic;
      control.classList.toggle("active", active);
      control.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
    });

    topicCards.forEach((card) => {
      const active = card.dataset.topicCard === topic;
      card.classList.toggle("active", active);
      card.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
    });

    if (emptyMessage) {
      emptyMessage.hidden = visibleCount !== 0;
    }

    if (shouldScroll) {
      document.querySelector("#listing-listing")?.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: "smooth",
        block: "start"
      });
    }
  };

  controls.forEach((control) => {
    control.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(control.classList.contains("active")));
    control.addEventListener("click", () => applyFilter(control.dataset.topic));
  });

  topicCards.forEach((card) => {
    card.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
    card.addEventListener("click", () => applyFilter(card.dataset.topicCard, true));
    card.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
        event.preventDefault();
        applyFilter(card.dataset.topicCard, true);
      }
    });
  });

  updateCountLabels();
  applyFilter("all");
});
</script>
```
